# Cobolt Machineries

> Cobolt Machineries (Cobolt Machineries Private Limited) is an engineering and machinery company based in Veemboor, Manjeri, Kerala, India. It supplies commercial food processing and kitchen equipment, stainless steel fabrication, custom machinery solutions, and installation, maintenance and repair services.

Key facts:
- Location: Veemboor, Manjeri, Kerala, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90617 82023 (24/7 hotline support listed on the site)
- Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm
- Equipment is built from food-grade SUS304/SUS316 stainless steel, with PLC automation on selected machines
- Focus areas: commercial food processing equipment (mixers, fryers, burners), stainless steel fabrication, custom-built machinery
- Services: installation and setup, preventive maintenance, repair, engineering consultation, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), custom machinery solutions
- Customers include food businesses, bakeries and commercial kitchens
- Sister organization: Entrain Culinary Academy (https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com), a culinary training school in Manjeri

## Featured products

- Table Top Food Mixer: Planetary mixer for bakeries and test kitchens
- BT Mixer: Commercial stand mixer with stainless steel components
- 2 Split Open Fryer (OFG321-322-323): Open fryer series
- Pressure Fryer Electric (PFE-800): Commercial electric pressure fryer
- Dacota 4 Burner: Commercial cooking range

See the [Products page](https://www.coboltmachineries.com/products) for the current catalogue and specifications.
